_readme: Template for ~/.secrets/mcp.json. Keep only the servers you use. Authenticated servers declare credentialSource as work or personal; values stay in that owning store and definitions contain ${VAR} references only. Reconcile one native consumer at a time using ~/.skills/sync/mcp.md, not the legacy generator. Definition metadata is not copied into native configs. Codex remains personal-only with no work credentials. Private-pack definitions belong in ~/.secrets/mcp.d/*.json.
